richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Agartala

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to municipal parks, schools, colleges and housing complexes in Agartala, the capital of Tripura. Our Fun Fitness machines are built at our factory in Vasai, about 1,960 km from Agartala, which makes this one of the longest road routes we handle. That distance changes how a project should be planned, so we keep the process simple.

Send us the site size, a few photos and the number of machines you have in mind. We send back a layout drawing, and once you approve it and the quote, we manufacture the full order and dispatch it in one consignment. Agartala gets heavy rain through the monsoon and stays humid for much of the year, so it helps to have the base work done before the truck arrives. A level, well-drained platform means the installers can fix every station in one visit instead of waiting for wet ground to dry out.

richText.heading: Planning an open air gym for Tripura's wet months

c: Long periods of rain and humidity are hard on painted mild steel. Our frames use galvanised pipe, which carries a 3-year warranty, and the seats, footplates and handles are roto-moulded plastic that does not rust. For an Agartala park we would look at the
. Together they cover legs, waist and cardio, and the twister lets three people use it at once during busy evening hours.

items.q: Is it worth ordering outdoor gym equipment from Vasai for a site in Agartala?
items.a: It works well when the whole order goes in one consignment. We manufacture everything after approval, dispatch it together by road and install it with our team or a dealer covering the northeast.

items.q: What base should we prepare before installation?
items.a: A firm, level area with a slight slope for rainwater. We tell you whether each machine will be grouted or self-standing, so your contractor can prepare the right base before dispatch.

items.q: Who handles repairs after installation in Tripura?
items.a: Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or write to aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Springs, bearings and spare parts are covered for 1 year against manufacturing defects.
